name: MultiMeter
description: Read an OWON B41T+ Bluetooth digital multimeter live inside Minerva. Your AI agent can read the current measurement, watch trends, press the meter's buttons, and record readings to CSV; the panel shows the live value with a rolling graph. Needs the meter powered on with its Bluetooth enabled and a Bluetooth radio on this computer; nothing else to install.

tools.name: minerva_multimeter_status
tools.description: Meter connection state, identity, latest reading, recording state.

tools.name: minerva_multimeter_read
tools.description: Latest measurement, optionally with recent history.

tools.name: minerva_multimeter_press
tools.description: Press a front-panel button (select, range, hold, rel, hz, maxmin).

tools.name: minerva_multimeter_record_start
tools.description: Start logging readings to a CSV.

tools.name: minerva_multimeter_record_stop
tools.description: Stop the recording and report the CSV path.

tools.name: minerva_multimeter_record_export
tools.description: Copy the last recording to a chosen path (host save dialog when no path is given).

events.name: multimeter.reading
events.description: One decoded measurement, emitted for every packet the meter sends (2-3 per second).
